intro: Please note that exact locations et level ranges are extremely hard to document. Both of my usual sources (Serebii et Bulbapedia) structure their locations et biomes drastically differently. Some pokemon that I've seen à locations myself resulted à one site having it listed pendant que le other doesn't, it also doesn't show which pokemon might be out of reach without ride upgrades so you will need to take this data avec pinch of salt! For fixed encounters (not including tera pokemon) that are also normally found à le same area I have omitted le data to avoid adding to what is already a data overload!
